migration_rules: S8 does not mandate a specific classification system at L4.
Named systems such as Uniclass or OmniClass are references/examples unless selected through governed requirements/project declarations.
Actual code lists remain separate machine-readable artifacts or authoritative external references.
Mapping and parameter-carrier rules must be governed and versioned rather than inferred from tool state.
Approval authority remains outside this registry and is governed by S1/project instruments.
